description: Search the Reelagio database of online slot games. Use it to find slots by name, or by any mix of provider, theme, feature, volatility, mechanic, max win and bonus buy. Filters combine with AND. Values are matched loosely ("pragmatic" finds Pragmatic Play, "fishing" finds the underwater theme), and `query` also understands a plain description such as "high volatility fishing slots with bonus buy". Returns up to `limit` slots, most popular first unless `sort` says otherwise, each with its specs and a link to its page, plus `total` matches. When nothing matches, the result says which value was not recognised or which filters clash, and lists the valid values. For the full spec sheet of one slot use get_slot.

bonusBuy.description: Only slots with (true) or without (false) a bonus buy

emoji.description: Emoji tags the slot must have, e.g. "🐵🏛️" (ALL must match)

features.description: Slot must have ALL of these features, e.g. ["free spins", "sticky wilds"]

gameType.description: How wins are formed: fixed (paylines), ways, megaways, cluster (cluster pays), scatter (pay anywhere) or collect

minMaxWin.description: Minimum max win as a multiple of the bet, e.g. 10000 for 10,000x

provider.description: Game studio, e.g. "Pragmatic Play"; part of the name is enough

query.description: A slot name or part of one ("big bass"), or a plain description of what to find ("megaways slots over 20,000x")

sort.description: Order of results: most popular first, or highest max win first

themes.description: Slot must have ANY of these themes, e.g. ["western"], ["egyptian", "greek"]

volatility.description: Slot volatility is ANY of these

name: search_slots
title: Search slots
